mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0%, it indicates severe labor market distress that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive month-over-month growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show positive growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), central bank tightening increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm employment indicates improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90 (index, 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in real GDP and industrial production indicates broad-based economic recovery that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and INDPRO show positive growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment recovery phases (UNRATE > 8%), policy stimulus and pent-up demand drive rapid equity market rebounds, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
